content.text:
I stopped after the fifth screen of seven. The numbers had worn me out, and what came next was "קרנות מחקות", which means nothing to me.

**What I'd tell my son:**

"Look, I didn't decide anything. I'll ask you, and ask the bank too. I'm not sure of much.

The page does show everything Harel has. It's called 'כל המוצרים של הראל' and says 105 products. For each one it gives the fee, 'דמי ניהול', and what it earned over 3 years and over 5 years.

The one that looked most like my deposit was 'כספי (שקלי)'. It has 0% in shares and 0% in אג"ח, so I understood it as money just sitting there. In one place it showed '4.25%' for 3 years with a fee of '0.57%'. In another place it showed '4.4%' for 3 years with '0.5%'. 'אג"ח סחיר' has 0% shares, but next to it was 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so I don't know how it's done.

What frightened me was the line saying 'מניות 99%' next to 'S&P 500'. Big numbers like '24.04%' or '21.45%' come with a lot of shares, and I remember what happened to me last time.

What bothered me most was the fees. Some are tiny, like '0.01%'. But in 'קרן חדשה מקיפה' it says '1.47%' 'מההפקדות', and I don't know if they take that from every shekel I put in. That would be a lot.

I didn't see the word 'פיקדון' anywhere, so I can't tell if it's as safe as the bank."

**My account of it:**

- **What I looked at, in order:**
  - The heading "הראל" and the line about fees as of 2025.
  - The row of product buttons. Most of them are pension things that aren't for me.
  - The "קופת גמל להשקעה" table, where I looked for "כספי" and "אג"ח".
  - The "קרן השתלמות" table, briefly.
  - "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים" and "קרן חדשה מקיפה". I hardly read these, because they're pension products.
  - The end of "מרכזית לפיצויים". Under it was a small note saying the return is before fees and tax, and that it "לא אומרת מה יקרה בהמשך".
- **What I skipped:** The little rings in two colours. I couldn't tell the colours apart. I also skipped the five-digit numbers next to each name, "כסף מנוהל", and the small notes marked "PF-06" and "PF-10".
- **Words I didn't understand:**
  - "S&P 500" and "עוקב מדד"
  - "גמיש", "סחיר" and "קיימות"
  - "מההפקדות" compared with "מהחיסכון"
  - "עוד לא דווח" and "פחות מ־3 שנים"
- **Where I got tired:** By the third screen it was all rows of percentages on a black background. The same names kept coming back with different numbers, and that made me anxious.
